0022600117.text: The Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the 76ers (3-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, on a three-game winning streak), with Detroit 1-0 on the road and Philadelphia 2-0 at home. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), while Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Joel Embiid (heel) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain).
